title: Beautiful Rock Kestrels occupying an owl box
description: In an estate in Melkbosstrand, a pair of Rock Kestrels have bred in an EcoSolutions owl box for the past 2 years. This year, the pair produced 4 youngsters who have fledged successfully from the owl box.
html: They say a picture speaks a thousand words ... These pictures speaks of proper box placement, annual box service, monitoring, homeowner delight and of course, Rock Kestrels (Falco tinnunculus)! Maintenance and annual substrate replacement is essential for owl box ccupancy. To arrange your annual service, book here.
